items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I mean I could play all of Roy Haynes’s licks but I’d never sound like Roy. But if I saw Roy or Art Blakey or any of those guys in later life when I got to know them

ctx.x: The big beat. Yeah. But I’d like you —

About the beat, it’s not like this, it’s like this, right? So the bigger it is the more you can subdivide and put stuff in there, but it starts before the beat and it ends after the beat. Does that make sense? It’s like you breathe 1-2-3-4, [different emphasis] uh 1, uh 2, uh 3, uh uh uh uh uh. So it’s like the upbeat to the downbeat — you know I was soaking up the influences I found, the drummers that I really, really liked and I would, well frankly emulate them and steal their stuff if I could. You know you…
Well your students probably would do the same thing with you.
